_comment: Compatibility grammar for source-derived cap components. Built BEFORE any remix is generated. A pair is ALLOW only where the source author demonstrates it or the constraint is structural; technically fitting pixels are never sufficient evidence of aesthetic compatibility.

cap2.source: Cap 2 — More Accessories and Stuff, by plurffle
cap2.recolour_note: pure greyscale, no ColorMasks declared, so Fashion Sense tints the WHOLE sprite; recolour is multiplicative over the authored value ladder

cap_snapback.source: Cap (Snapback) — More Accessories and Stuff, by plurffle
cap_snapback.status: PRESERVED as a separate future architecture; NOT processed, NOT merged with cap2
cap_snapback.rule: never averaged, derived or merged with cap2 into a universal cap

front_emblem.per_view_note: the author draws it front-only; the element is not visible in profile or from behind, so no side or back variant exists or should be invented
front_emblem.evidence: the author places the identical element at the identical cells on Cap 1, a different construction — two independent uses
front_emblem.occupancy: visor_face is a single-occupancy region; nothing else may be placed there
front_emblem.size_limits: must fit the flat field it sits on: 4 wide x 1 tall at x8-11, y10; the field is only 1 row deep, so a taller motif would cross into the authored visor edge
front_emblem.scale_limits: authored at the base's own 20x20 grid; no scaling
front_emblem.palette_roles: steps 3 and 5 of the base's own vocabulary — it recolours WITH the garment, not against it; it is cloth, not metal
front_emblem.coexists_with_other_decorations: no other component exists for this base yet; the question is deferred rather than answered

crown_highlight.decision: LEFT EMBEDDED in the base; not offered to the generator
crown_highlight.why: it is the specular highlight of this dome. Cap 1's crown is shaded entirely differently, so the element does not travel. Extracting lighting as a movable part would be forcing a separation the author never made.

cap2 x front_emblem.why: the author's own construction; reconstruction from base + component is pixel-exact

cap2 x crown_highlight.why: not offered as a component; it is part of the base

cap_snapback x front_emblem.why: no author evidence. Snapback has no front emblem and its front face is shaded differently; the pixels would fit and the result would be invention, not derivation. Revisit only if Snapback is processed and evidence appears.

any non-SOFT_CAP base x front_emblem.why: outside the family the author demonstrated

cap2 x any old soft_cap asset.why: the procedural soft_cap is rejected research; its components are excluded from promotion

allowed: palette / recolour — the base is pure greyscale and authored to be tinted
front_emblem present or absent, at its authored cells
forbidden: any component not proven by exact reconstruction
